# Owner paths. A PR that changes one passes "Owner OK" only while it carries
# the owner-ok label that the owner set on its head commit, so a later push
# needs the label again (docs/plan.md, section 6). The approval workflow reads
# this file from the default branch, so a PR cannot shorten it for itself.
#
# The owner approves only changes to the licences, the exceptions to the
# names rule and this list. The review agent approves the rest. Every PR
# from an account other than the owner's needs the owner's approving review
# anyway ("Outside approval"), whatever it changes.
#
# One glob per line, from the repository root: ** spans folders, * and ? stay
# inside one name, and a pattern without a slash matches at the root only.
# Matching ignores case.
#
# Until NortFox keeps real books, the database migrations are not an owner
# path. There are no real books yet, so a mistake in a ledger rule can still
# be fixed freely, and the tests guard the rules. db/migrations/** goes back
# on this list before NortFox keeps real books (docs/plan.md, step 4d).

# The licences.
**/LICENSE*
**/LICENCE*
**/COPYING*

# The exceptions to the names rule: a marker, and the folders where one counts.
**/.protected-name-ok
.github/protected-name-allowlist.txt

# This list, so that a PR cannot shorten it.
.github/owner-paths.txt
